messages:
sara_support: FYI customer (AcmeCorp) opened a ticket — console filters not applied when they select region=eu-west-1 AND model_version filter. They see total token counts but per-model breakdown shows 0. cc @james_sre @mia_frontend :eyes:

james_sre: Can you paste repro steps? Is this new after any deploy?

sara_support: Steps from customer (trimmed):
1) Console -> Analytics -> Select org AcmeCorp
2) Set Region = eu-west-1, Model = redwood-7b, Version = v2025-03-01
3) Time range = last 24h
Expected: per-model rows with counts. Actual: global totals present, per-model rows empty (0).
They attached screenshot link: https://files.internal/acme/screens/12345.png
Also tried the API export button -> returns CSV with only a single "total_tokens" row, no model tags.

mia_frontend: Hmm could be UI not sending all params to the analytics API. Any network traces from the browser? Ask them to check devtools for the XHR payload.

analytics_bot: pipeline-ingest: metrics-ingest lag=42m for region=eu-west-1 at 1765012200 (recent spike)

james_sre: I pulled the analytics service logs for AcmeCorp around the customer's query time. The UI did send region+model+version, but our analytics query builder is dropping the version when region tag exists. See excerpt (sanitized):
```
INFO 2025-10-12T08:12:34Z request_id=abc123 params={org:acme, region:eu-west-1, model: redwood-7b, version:v2025-03-01}
DEBUG query=SELECT sum(tokens) FROM metrics WHERE org='acme' AND tags @> ['region:eu-west-1'] AND tags @> ['model:redwood-7b'] -- version filter omitted during normalize_tags()
```
Looks like normalize_tags() collapsed version into a single 'model' tag for some recent tag-normalization change (PR #4823) which was rolled out yesterday.

sara_support: That matches the customer's timeline — they said it started after the console upgrade last night.

mia_frontend: If normalize_tags removed the separate version tag, the UI still queries for it so it becomes a no-op filter and returns empty rows for per-version breakdowns. Quick workaround for affected customers: remove the version filter in the console to get totals while we fix.

james_sre: Repro locally with the new normalization:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" "https://analytics.internal/v1/metrics?org=acme&region=eu-west-1&model=redwood-7b&version=v2025-03-01" | jq
# output: {"total_tokens": 123456, "breakdown": []}
```
If I query without version param it returns breakdown with model/version tags.

oncall_eng: Assigning to eng-analytics oncall, starting a rollback of PR #4823 to staging. ETA 30m.

deploy-bot: deploy starting: rollback-pr-4823 -> analytics-svc-2025-10-12T08:40Z

james_sre: Plan: rollback tag-normalization change to restore previous tag shape, run consistency job to re-index the last 48h (fast path: re-run ingestion for affected orgs) OR patch normalize_tags to preserve version as separate tag. I'll push the rollback and open a hotfix PR to preserve version tag.

sara_support: Thanks — I've trigged the support ticket update and told the customer the engineering team is rolling back the change and will follow up. Please post here when rollback complete so I can update SLA notes. :thumbsup:

analytics_bot: rollback complete: analytics-svc v2.14.7 deployed. ingestion-consistency job queued for AcmeCorp (job_id=j-9988).

james_sre: Verified: queries with region+model+version now return per-version rows again on staging. Will monitor prod metrics for 20m then mark incident resolved.

sara_support: Closing loop with customer, will leave ticket open until consistency job finishes. Thanks everyone.
